svg.aria-label: Two tests, and neither is administered in Dubai
svg.text: Two tests, and neither is administered in Dubai
Have you ceased to be resident in the United Kingdom?
Administered by HMRC. Nothing the Emirates do affects it.
Does the convention treat you as a resident of the UAE?
Domicile, habitual abode or centre of vital interests — not nationality.
The absence of Emirati income tax reaches you only after both are answered.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 9 September 2026
